dataset_metadata.name: Degradation of Commercial Lithium-Ion Cells as a Function of Chemistry and Cycling Conditions
dataset_metadata.citation: Preger et al., J. Electrochem. Soc. 167 120532 (2020). DOI: 10.1149/1945-7111/abae37
dataset_metadata.funding: US Department of Energy Office of Electricity, Energy Storage Program

cell_info.cell_notes: 9 cycling conditions (3 DOD x 3 discharge rates). Voltage range 2.0-3.6 V. Max discharge 30 A.
6 cycling conditions (3 DOD x 2 discharge rates; 3C excluded per manufacturer spec). Voltage range 2.5-4.2 V. Max discharge 6 A. ICP-OES composition Ni0.81Co0.14Al0.05.
9 cycling conditions (3 DOD x 3 discharge rates). Voltage range 2.0-4.2 V. Max discharge 20 A. ICP-OES composition Ni0.84Mn0.06Co0.10 (Ni-enriched NMC811 variant).

aging_modes.notes: All cells charged at 0.5C per manufacturer guidance. NCA cells excluded from 3C discharge (outside manufacturer spec). Test matrix: 9 conditions for LFP and NMC, 6 conditions for NCA (no 3C conditions). At least 2 cells per condition. Study considered complete once a cell reached 80% of initial capacity; LFP cells in most conditions had not reached EOL by study end. EIS performed at approximately 3% capacity loss intervals (results to be reported separately).

time_protocol.test_equipment: Arbin SCTS; Arbin LBT21084 high-precision multichannel battery testing system; SPX Tenney Model T10C-1.5 environmental chambers
time_protocol.notes: Round of cycling varied from 125 to 1000 cycles per cell; halved if cell experienced >5% capacity loss in prior round. Study duration described as nearly three years. LFP cells reached up to ~9000 EFC; NCA 250–1500 EFC; NMC 200–2500 EFC.

rawdata.data_quality_notes: Periodic spikes in capacity data at transitions between capacity check cycles and normal cycling rounds.
rawdata.known_issues: Periodic spikes in the data due to transition between the three-cycle capacity check and the normal round of cycling.

checkup.notes: Capacity check: 3 charge/discharge cycles from 0–100% SOC at 0.5C with CV taper to 0.05 A. Performed at the start and end of each cycling round; round length varied from 125 to 1000 cycles. EIS performed at intervals of approximately 3% capacity loss; EIS results to be published separately.

notes: Multi-chemistry cycling aging study comparing commercial LFP (A123 APR18650M1A), NCA (Panasonic NCR18650B), and NMC (LG Chem 18650HG2) 18650 cells. Factors varied: temperature (15, 25, 35 °C), depth of discharge (40–60%, 20–80%, 0–100% SOC), and discharge C-rate (0.5C, 1C, 2C, 3C; 3C excluded for NCA). All cycling files publicly available at batteryarchive.org. License stated in paper as CC BY-NC-ND 4.0. Data hosted and described at https://www.batteryarchive.org/snl_study.html.
